name: mac-fan-control
title: Mac Fan Control
description: Read and force Apple Silicon fan speed directly through the SMC.
author: triuzzi

commands.name: fan-status
commands.title: Fan Status
commands.description: Show live fan speed, control mode and CPU/GPU temperature.

commands.name: set-fan-speed
commands.title: Set Fan Speed
commands.description: Force every fan to a percentage of its hardware range.

commands.name: maximum
commands.title: Set Fans to Maximum
commands.description: Force every fan to its hardware maximum.

commands.name: automatic
commands.title: Set Fans to Automatic
commands.description: Hand every fan back to SMC firmware control.

commands.name: fan-menu-bar
commands.title: Fan Menu Bar
commands.description: Show current fan speed in the menu bar.
